name.value: Rosemead House (nee The Olde English Inn)

description.value: Rosemead House is a 28-room luxury boutique hotel occupying a restored 1906 Edwardian manor in Esquimalt, formerly known as The Olde English Inn. Rooms are split between the historic Manor Collection and the more modern Grove Collection, with the latter offering elevator access. The property includes an on-site restaurant, Janevca Kitchen & Lounge, and a spa, positioning it as a high-end destination stay near Victoria.
